ev.q: Among 1,622 persons enrolled into an automated symptom monitoring system, 190 (11.7%) developed COVID-19.
Four (2.1%) patients were hospitalized, and one (0.5%) died.
Among all enrollees, 190 (11.7%) met the COVID-19 case definition.
During May 14–July 10, Maine reported 1,869 total COVID-19 cases
This activity was determined to meet the requirements of public health surveillance
